(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Mostly good, minor comments inline. The two prototypes only have to live in the exported lib-lnet.h because lnet_res_lock()/lnet_net_lock() are static inlines there; if those inlines also moved to an lnet-internal header, the whole per-CPT lock API could stay private and the EXPORT_SYMBOL()s could go with it. Worth considering as a follow-on.

commit.message:
LU-18687 lnet: make lock.h an internal lnet header

The locking code in lock.h is an internal implementation
detail of LNet. It should not be exported for consumption
by other modules (like Lustre).
